query: Write a production Terraform module to provision Amazon S3 Tables, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation LF-Tags, and Redshift Serverless with KMS encryption.
Author AWS CDK TypeScript constructs for a private 3-AZ Amazon MSK cluster and Amazon OpenSearch Service domain with RemovalPolicy.RETAIN.
Provision an AWS Glue 5.0 PySpark Iceberg ETL job and least-privilege IAM execution role using Terraform.
Configure aws_s3tables_table_bucket in Terraform with SSE-KMS encryption and automated Iceberg unreferenced file removal maintenance.
Harden our analytics Terraform stack with manage_admin_password = true on Redshift Serverless and prevent_destroy lifecycle rules on stateful stores.
Debug why a single task in our Amazon MWAA Airflow DAG failed yesterday in CloudWatch logs.
Find which existing table in our Glue Data Catalog contains the customer_churn_score column.
Run an ad-hoc Athena SQL time-travel query (`FOR TIMESTAMP AS OF`) on an existing Iceberg table.
